lead.para: Khakbaz is the Wikipedia account of Sina K. Heshmati, a Brussels-based builder working across data, knowledge representation, software, and public documentation.
This page is a simple editor introduction so other contributors can quickly see the main public links and topic interests behind the account.

section.title: About
section.para: I work on data and knowledge systems, open publication workflows, and software projects that connect technical structure with public explanation.
Outside direct article work, I use public repositories and writing spaces to document ideas, prototypes, and long-form notes in the open.
